name: ServiceNow
description: Connector for performing various operations against ServiceNow datasource.

meta.name: instance_name
meta.description: Unique instance name as part of base url

meta.name: page_size
meta.description: Number of records to retrieve per API page when fetching various objects. Please enter a page size between 100 and 1000

meta.name: batch_size
meta.description: Number of parent objects whose related data (user roles, group users, group roles, role's child roles) are fetched in a single batch. Please enter a batch size between 1 and 50
